title: Discovering the Map
shot: top-down on the platform, then medium profile
camera: crane down onto the stone platform, then rise to a profile two-shot with KAIRO
action: An ancient circular map lies on the stone platform: unusual symbols, geometric rings, mysterious markings. KAIRO approaches it carefully.
lighting: the map catches a cold light and returns a faint amber warmth
audio: the tone becomes harmonic; a soft stone-on-stone scrape as he steps closer
dialogue_fa: روی اون سنگ، یه چیزی بود... شبیه نقشه. ولی نه نقشه‌ای که تا اون روز دیده بودم.
gloss_en: On that stone there was something... like a map. But not a map like any I had seen before.
continuity: map design locked here through S24
transition: his hand rises, motivating the macro insert
image_prompt: High angle looking down at a waist-high ancient stone platform inside a dark cave chamber. On it rests a circular amber stone tablet engraved with concentric rings, twelve radial grooves, small star-point markers and unknown angular glyphs. A faint cold light from above and a warm amber glow from the tablet itself. KAIRO the stickman's thin shadow reaches the edge of frame. 2D cinematic animation, intricate etched detail.
video_prompt: Crane down onto the stone platform until the circular map fills the frame, then rise smoothly to a profile shot where KAIRO steps up beside it, leaning in, spear now resting against the stone. The etched lines catch the light as the angle changes.
